name: @agarciadelrio/svg2symbol

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/index.js && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs && bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/cli.js && bun x tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
